messages:
sam: FYI customer 'financeapp-prod' reporting 503s from hosted inference since ~09:05 PT; they see streaming timeouts then 503s. Raised incident.
oncall-bot: Alert: hosted-api upstream_503_rate > 5% in us-west-2 at 09:06:12
maria: Looking now. Early sign: upstream runner restarts on a subset of GPU nodes.
jon: Any obvious trigger? model swap, long context, or a deploy?
sam: Customer said they switched to a new system prompt + long context around the same time.
maria: Pulling logs from runner -> repeated `CUDA out of memory` then a segfault. Backtrace points at kvcache prefetch code.
maria: Example log: ```2026-03-18T16:05:34Z runner[4212]: ERROR gpu_allocator: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (alloc 512MB) kv_cache_used=18.2GB model=v1.3-llama prefetch=true
2026-03-18T16:05:34Z runner[4212]: FATAL sigsegv at 0x7f9a1... backtrace: kvcache.cpp:214 -> prefetch.cpp:89 -> runtime.cpp:412```
jon: kv_cache ~18GB is pretty high for that model. Did autoscaler change instance type or memory config?
eva: CS: customers reported 500s during billing window and opened a support escalation. Asking for ETA.
maria: Repro so far: run repeated streaming requests with history ~100k tokens and a model swap; OOM reproduces within 3-4 requests.
jon: Suspect interaction between quantization swap landed in the patch yesterday and the prefetch path. Quant change could alter gpu memory alignment/peaks. Also a bug might double allocate temp buffers on swap.
maria: Observed container lifecycle: kube evict -> container restart -> prefetch on coldstart -> immediate OOM -> coredump -> restart loop.
oncall-bot: Deploy note: quant-runtime patch v2026-03-17-qa rolled to subset at 08:59; affected pool=hosted-pool-7.
sam: Timeline matches the patch. Customer timeline aligns with deploy.
jon: Two-pronged likely: (1) quant runtime increases peak for some workloads, (2) prefetch does an extra allocation on hot model swap. Combined -> exceed gpu memory.
maria: Immediate mitigation: disable prefetch on affected pool and throttle concurrency. Rolling now.
maria: Commands run: `kubectl -n hosted set env ds/infer-pool-7 PREFETCH_ENABLED=false` and `rhctl scale-policy update --pool hosted-pool-7 --max-concurrency 1`
sam: CS notified customer to retry and is collecting request ids. They want logs and a timeline.
eva: Prepare a short customer explanation: what happened, what we mitigated, and ETA for permanent fix.
jon: Minimal repro snippet (python): ```# hit endpoint with long history
for i in range(10):
  r = requests.post(url, json={"messages": history, "model": "v1.3-llama"})
  print(r.status_code, r.text[:200])
```
maria: After disabling prefetch, 503 rate dropped from ~6% to 0.8% in 10m and nodes stabilized.
sam: Customer confirms endpoints back to normal. They're asking for credit for ~30m impact window.
eva: I'll file the credit request. Need incident id + timeframe.
maria: Incident id: infra_2026-03-18-9376. Affected pool: hosted-pool-7. Impact window: 2026-03-18T16:05Z -> 2026-03-18T16:35Z.
jon: Root cause hypothesis: quantization runtime change + prefetch path double-alloc on model hot-swap -> GPU OOM -> segfault -> container restart loop -> upstream 503s.
jon: Post-mortem action items: revert quant patch for fleet, add prefetch guard to check available GPU memory before allocating, add end-to-end test for model swap memory accounting.
maria: Opening follow-ups: INF-3245 revert quant patch, INF-3246 add prefetch memory guard, INF-3247 add kv_cache observability & alerting.
sam: Thanks. CS will follow up with customer for credits and RCA once we confirm root cause.
eva: Also recommend telling customers short-term mitigations: reduce context window, avoid simultaneous model swaps during high-QPS, or pin to older model variant until patch rollback.
maria: Closing triage for now. Will post full RCA after infra/eng confirm root cause and fix.
